sv.title: Musikjätten flyttar in hos Balder
sv.summary: Warner Music Group flyttar in i A House, den före detta arkitekthögskolan i Stockholm, och får fastighetsbolaget Balder som hyresvärd. Det rapporterar Di:s systertidning Fastighetsnytt.

en.title: Music giant moves into Balder building
en.summary: Warner Music Group is moving into A House, the former architecture college in Stockholm, with the property company Balder as landlord. Di's sister publication Fastighetsnytt reports this.
